overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on machine translation using selective fine-tuning of LLMs with language-aware neuron routing. It evaluates using standard automatic metrics (BLEU/sacreBLEU) but does not use human evaluation or LLM-as-judge approaches. The main contribution is the LANDeRMT framework for mitigating catastrophic forgetting and parameter interference in multilingual MT.
